title: Add user search for the admin console
description: Support asked for a search box in the admin console. Adds `search_users`, a case-insensitive match on username or email.

expected_issues.description: The search term is interpolated into the SQL text with an f-string, so a term like `' OR 1=1 --` rewrites the query. Use a bound parameter (`ILIKE %s` with `f"%{term}%"` passed as a parameter) like `get_user_by_id` does.
